name: Stash
description: Organise your adult video collection, with tags, scenes and scrapers.

paths.name: .Stash
paths.description: Stash's settings (config.yml), database and plugins. Back this folder up.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Your video and picture library. It starts as /mnt/cache/media; change it to the folder you keep your collection in.

paths.name: Blobs
paths.description: Cover images and other pictures Stash stores.

paths.name: Generated
paths.description: Previews, sprites and thumbnails Stash makes. Can grow large; Stash can make them again.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Stash web page and API, published on host as 6746

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: STASH_STASH
variables.description: The library folder inside the container. Leave it as /data/.

variables.name: STASH_GENERATED
variables.description: Where previews and sprites go. Leave it as /generated/.

variables.name: STASH_METADATA
variables.description: Where exports and backups go. Leave it as /metadata/.

variables.name: STASH_CACHE
variables.description: Where temporary files go. Leave it as /cache/.
